name: MedicationR6CourseDetails
title: Compact R5 course metadata and local dosage deltas
description: Preserves only phase metadata and dosage semantics absent from native R5 fields. Each live row owns its local delta; course-wide metadata is written once and referenced by context. No complete course or ordinary dosage snapshot is replicated. All content uses named typed extensions, never JSON strings.

element.isModifierReason: Contains local phase timing, unrepresentable dosage fields, or a required reference to shared course metadata. Ignoring it can change administration semantics.

Unresolved course or predecessor identity preserved on a surviving component. The reserved value conflicting-phase marks contradictory executable metadata for that component phase; preserve it across saving and remove it only after explicitly reconciling the retained variants. Numeric execution requires resolved context; editing and rendering remain available.
Read-only historical complete-course representation. New writers emit local step/component deltas and a single shared metadata owner.
